confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Food and drink anchors sit between the supplied Kyoto and Hiroshima observations. Accommodation is least certain given July demand and Kyoto/Osaka day-trip spillover. The cocktail and wine_glass anchors are not directly observed; they are set at about 1.5x and 1.6x the beer anchor. The FX figure was taken from search snippets of the RBA exchange-rate table, which showed a stale date stamp; confirm it on the live RBA page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kansai-region tourist city priced between Hiroshima and Kyoto, mostly leaning toward Hiroshima. Beer, coffee, inexpensive meal, and hostel and hotel anchors are interpolated between those two cities. The mid-range meal is set close to the shared Kyoto/Hiroshima figure of 30.52. Hong Kong was not used as a basis.
